title: Polydome: Sustainable Urban Agriculture System
reason: Discusses the vision for sustainable agriculture and the development of a new system called Polydome.

tasks.task: Present the concept of Polydome as a solution for sustainable agriculture.

subtasks.text: Explain the idea of an urban greenhouse that serves as a local supermarket.
Describe the food-producing ecosystem within the Polydome, including fish, mushrooms, and fruit trees.

tasks.task: Outline the development process and research behind the Polydome system.

subtasks.text: Mention the support from Dutch partner organizations and the research trajectory.
Describe the methods used to develop the process for designing greenhouse ecosystems.

tasks.task: Highlight the benefits of the Polydome system.

subtasks.text: Explain how Polydome can produce high-value niche products for local sale.
Describe the impact of Polydome on food security and access.
Mention the open-source research document and the goal to build a first pilot.
